author: Jim Kelley
text: They set up an appointment for us just a day or two ahead. Mike showed up right when he said he would. It was a complicated issue (we thought) with our reverse osmosis system. He figured out a brilliant solution (that was much better than the original installation),  and gave us the price all within minutes. A short time later he announced he was finished and charged us exactly the price he told us. We could'nt be happier with our new plumber!

author: Kelly Cassidy
text: After receiving four proposals from plumbers I selected Pine County Plumbing and so glad that I did.  They are responsive and professional.  Not only did they offer the best price to repair my outdoor drain from root invasion, but they also did it with the most advanced equipment and no need to tear up my yard.  I would highly recommend Pine Country Plumbing for any plumbing needs.

author: Manzanita Village
text: Mike with Pine Country plumbing came to our HOA to help resolve a tricky plumbing problem where a grinder pump line was broken owing to too much pressure from our private Low Pressure Sewer line. He came, put in a fix and returned to find that although he worked at it and did the best he could, he was unable to fix the problem so he helped us find another company to do it AND Mike did not charge us at all since, in his words, he could not fix it. Now THAT'S not your everyday company. We are very grateful to Pine Country and especially to Mike.

author: Dustin Rigg
text: Mike is great! honest... looked at the clamp done on the leak, and stated nothing needs to be done... Because I have buyers who wanted it to be replaced, he did it so it had a "3" year warranty... super fast and professional!

author: Mike Anders
text: Highly recommend! Great reliable plumbers that know what they’re doing, reliable and easy to communicate with. 5 star experience from a phone call to job completion.
